reply.analysis: Not closed: the verdict is a gap, bracket [136, 152]. The lower bound 136 comes from a verified independent set and matches the CP-SAT alpha baseline, which proved 136 in 23.1 s. The upper bound 152 comes from a verified clique cover, not from a code. The rule's code (p=2, c=1) gave length above 151 on this perturbed K(18,3) graph. Codes_tried stays at 1, so the spectral fallback in the revised plan seems never to have produced a code. Against the baselines, the upper bound 152 is far better than cpsat_cover 433, frac_cover 492 and kushagra_agent 732, and wall time was 64.7 s against about 121 s for each of those. Almost all of that time was LLM time (llm_s 64.0 vs compute_s 0.66), so the LLM, not compute, set the cost.
